title: Proposed experiment testing Penrose gravitational collapse with entangled nanocrystals

tellings.quote: And actually a recent experiment was just proposed um called the G experiment taking two um two nano crystals entangle them magnetically

plain: Matthew Pines, a commentator on security and technology, tells podcast host Jesse Michels about a newly proposed experiment he calls the G experiment. He says it would take two tiny crystals and link them magnetically, so their quantum states depend on each other, to test the physicist Roger Penrose's idea that gravity makes quantum possibilities collapse into one outcome, an idea Pines connects to Penrose's collaborator Stuart Hameroff. If it works, it could put that idea to a real test for the first time.
